blackboard.strategy_router: strategy-registry.mjs decides HOW cajh trades, never whether. selectStrategy({asset,regime,timeframe}) ALWAYS returns a strategy; confidence is expressed as POSITION SIZE (validated 1.0x / relative 0.5x / uncovered 0.25x), so weak evidence shrinks exposure instead of blocking a trade. No PASS exists yet, so nothing sizes above 0.5x and expectedEdge reads negative - tests assert both, so a future edit claiming a positive edge without new sealed evidence FAILS the suite rather than quietly trading on it. Adding a PASS entry requires a genuine sealed verdict plus the D3 human gate.

blackboard.momentum_harness_gap: Ran both existing momentum harnesses against the real data (watchlist gap now fixed). Neither matches MOMENTUM_SPEC.md's pre-registration: (1) runMomentumStudy (wired to `research.js momentum`, produced the existing ROADMAP M7 'KILLED' verdict) computes symbolHoldout by ranking ONLY among PRIMARY_SYMBOL_HOLDOUT (3 fixed symbols: ATOM/DOT/LTC) - structurally below M_min=8 (MOMENTUM_SPEC.md sec 3.5) FOREVER, regardless of data availability. Re-ran it just now: symbolHoldout.n = 0, identical to the recorded verdict - confirms this was never a data-gate issue for this function, it's a permanent design limitation. (2) runSealedMomentumPanelStudy (momentum.mjs:230, has tests, never run against real data before) correctly widens the holdout universe to available-minus-primaryUniverse (this is what PWR1 diagnosed - 81 eligible dates) but its primary-cell loop (momentum.mjs ~262-280) calls buildMomentumPanel WITHOUT `transform`, so it silently scores train/recentHoldout/symbolHoldout on RAW returns - contradicting MOMENTUM_SPEC.md sec 2.1, which explicitly settles market-neutral RESIDUAL (T2) as the one pre-registered, gated statistic ('the pass/kill gate in sec 6 is applied to residual, not raw'). Fixing this means adding a primaryTransform parameter (or hardcoding btcResidual90) to that call - a signature/behavior change, and the existing test for this function (momentum.test.mjs:172) uses an 80-bar synthetic fixture that is too short for the 90-bar residual window default, so it would need updating too. Per AGENT_PROTOCOL.md, changing an established function's behavior/signature over a design gap is an Architect call, not an Executor one - not silently redesigning it here. No ROADMAP verdict written; the existing M7 KILLED entry is unchanged and should NOT be treated as confirmed or superseded until this is resolved with a harness that actually implements the pre-registration.
